general.notes: Operating distance stated as 2–500 m (Recommended Operating Conditions). Reach in title/ordering is 500 m. Average launch power min (-2.9 dBm) per lane note 1 is informative. Receiver sensitivity (OMAouter) max is Max(–3.9, SECQ – 5.3) dBm (informative, note 3) for SECQ up to 3.4 dB. Stressed receiver sensitivity -1.9 dBm (OMAouter) per note 4 at BER = 2.4x10^-4 with conformance test signal at TP3; stressed test SECQ 3.4 dB, aggressor OMAouter 4.2 dBm. Transmitter reflectance defined looking into transmitter (note 2). TDECQ max 3.4 dB per lane. Title wavelength 1310 nm; optical table λ 1304.5–1317.5 nm typ 1311 nm.
